chapter: Eight Locales Over Mountains and Seas: The Wonders of Adeptal Amber
act_title: Eight Locales Over Mountains and Seas: The Wonders of Adeptal Amber

quests.title: Eight Locales Over Mountains and Seas: The Wonders of Adeptal Amber

dialogue.t: Hello— Mountain Shaper—!
Hello— Mon-Mon—
Argh, seems like the adeptus isn't at home...

dialogue.sit: Let's not be impolite to the adepti, now.

dialogue.t: Paimon, what are adepti?
Hmm... They're very special people... Or very special animals?
Like Kichiboushi?
Uh, not exactly! They have mystical powers...
They can "kapow"? Then, Kichiboushi also adeptus.
Um, adepti are much more ancient, and they have a certain... Prestige? Dignity?
Oh. Then Kichiboushi, not adeptus. Ioroi is adeptus!
Ugh, this is pretty hard to explain.

dialogue.sit: The adepti are ancient powers who defend Liyue.

dialogue.t: Kichiboushi understands. Ioroi protects Chinju Forest, so not adeptus.
Paimon's pretty sure that's not how it works, but if it clears up any misunderstandings...
But since we've got this adeptus' abode in front of us, let's take a picture of Kichiboushi right here!
Mm! Kichiboushi, pose for picture!
Good Kichiboushi!
That was a great shot!
Mmhaha! Kichiboushi, handsome!
This kid's got zero humility...
Ooh. Paimon, adepti use what magic?
The adepti are super powerful. For example...

dialogue.sit: Let's start with the amber around here.

dialogue.t: What is amber?
Oh, Paimon remembers this one. Mountain Shaper has flowers that can create amber to trap bad things that invade his land inside them.
Mon-Mon, very powerful. Defends Liyue by trapping bad things.
Long ago, the very, very bad Four Oni of Ogata came into the forest and bullied many bake-danuki. Ioroi transformed into an official, gave them bake-danuki food to eat.
Later, Ioroi and Otogi King threw them into paper and sealed them.
Huh, so there's that sort of story too. No wonder Ioroi panicked when he saw that picture of Kichiboushi.
Ioroi is not adeptus, not defending Liyue. But Ioroi protects the forest. He protects tanuki.

dialogue.sit: Different people have different things they need to defend.

dialogue.t: Mm?

dialogue.sit: You'll figure it out once you're older, Kichiboushi.

dialogue.t: That's why you've gotta train hard and become a super strong bake-danuki!
Mm! Of course! The world-famous bake-danuki, Kichiboushi!
Paimon's really curious to know what Ioroi used to look like before he was sealed. He was probably a ball of fun!
Huh, Paimon's suddenly reminded of those Treasure Hoarders who were trapped in amber...

dialogue.sit: They even took us for adepti messengers...

dialogue.t: That feels like it was so long ago now. But at the same time, it wasn't, right?
Mm?
Ahem. Well, when we came to Liyue...
"The Rite of Descension only happens once a year! Ahaha, I, {NICKNAME}, am gonna have all that delicious food! Come on, Paimon, let's go!"

dialogue.sit: "And all the offerings, too! Paimon's flying over there right now!"
Best we stop misrepresenting events...

dialogue.t: Okay, okay...

dialogue.sit:
You explain what happened in Liyue in simpler terms.
You stop at the point where you went to seek the adepti out in Minlin.

dialogue.t: ...As for what happened next, {NICKNAME} and Paimon went to that Liuli Pavilion place we were at earlier.
Mon-Mon and Clow-Clow, very powerful! They built a moving house!
Clow-Cl— Cloud Retainer really loves gourmet food as well! We had to make lots of delicious stuff before we could meet with her.
Greedy, like Paimon.

dialogue.sit: Like Paimon indeed.
She can fly, too.

dialogue.t: Hey!
Is Paimon adeptus? Paimon is very powerful.
Uhh, this is kinda complicated. That was praise, sure, but Paimon doesn't feel so good about it...
But either way, Paimon isn't an adeptus!
Want to play with adepti!
The adepti don't generally appear before people. But we can have a look around. It's pretty nice here.
Kichiboushi, go!
Thank goodness we found you! Are you alright, Kichiboushi?
*whimpers*
Don't worry, it's okay. But don't run off by yourself next time, alright?

dialogue.sit: You're like his big sister, Paimon.
You're like his mom, Paimon.
Paimon's like his granny.

dialogue.t: Paimon's older than Kichiboushi. Of course Paimon's the big sister!

dialogue.sit: Though I could hardly tell...

dialogue.t: Hey!
Mm-mm! Thank you, {NICKNAME}. Thank you, Paimon.
Kichiboushi, almost sealed! Very scary. But Paimon calling Kichiboushi, so not so scary.
Ah, right, Ioroi did say that some smaller tanuki were also sealed...
Inside amber, very scary. Dark, cannot see. Cannot talk. Cannot move. Cannot "kapow"! Like becoming stone.
Ioroi is stone, but still very powerful. Can talk, can see. But cannot move.

dialogue.sit: Would you like to help Ioroi, Kichiboushi?
Aye, we'll protect you.

dialogue.t: Mm. Then, help other stone tanuki too!
But we're here with you right now, Kichiboushi. We won't let you be sealed!
Yey!
But you mustn't be too naughty, either!
Mm. Yes.
That's a good boy! Shall we stop here for now? You must need some rest too, Kichiboushi.
Not tired!
Ooh, isn't this a pickle. If Kichiboushi won't be good, then Paimon doesn't know where we should go next...
Mm...

dialogue.sit: Kichiboushi begrudgingly admits to being tired...

dialogue.t: Phew! Kichiboushi really is like a child.

dialogue.sit: And you're getting better at dealing with then, eh, Paimon?

dialogue.t: Really? Maybe that's because Paimon's been traveling with you for so long! Hehe.

dialogue.sit: Oh, treating me like a kid now, are we?
Hmm, come to think of it, we have had to take care of many children...

dialogue.t: No, no! Haven't we been accompanying kids a lot? You know, like Dusky Ming and Changchang...
Paimon's definitely learned a lot from traveling with you.
And this time, the lesson is... Bake-danuki and adepti might not get along.
We've got to give our next destination some thought...

quests.description: You agreed to Ioroi’s request to “bring Kichiboushi out to train.” You’ll try taking him to see the places where the adepti live this time. Perhaps Mt. Hulao might be a decent choice…
